findings.title: Manifest never supplies thermal evidence
findings.why_it_matters: The adopted `make -C zapote unit-run` manifest deserializes the new optional field as `None`, so every PowerEntry run records the numerical rule as indeterminate and never replays the retained bridge-neck model. The new required rule is still marked executed, which makes the harness look integrated while it only proves that evidence was omitted. Point the PowerEntry manifest at a tracked real-board assessment and resolve that path like the other manifest-relative inputs so the numerical replay, current binding, and tamper checks actually run.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `thermal_evidence` to the PowerEntry entry in `zapote/validation/units.json`, pointing at a committed real-board assessment directory; include `s.thermal_evidence.iter_mut()` in the manifest-relative rebasing loop in `src/bin/zapote-unit-run.rs`; add an end-to-end manifest test that requires a replayed numerical result rather than the missing-evidence finding.
evidence: zapote/validation/units.json:65-66 -- "composite": null followed by the closing PowerEntry object; it has no `thermal_evidence` member.
zapote/packages/zapote-harness/src/bridge_thermal.rs:27-30 -- Finding::indeterminate(NUMERICAL_RULE, "bridge-neck thermal evidence directory was not supplied", "power-entry.bridge-necks")

findings.title: Mesher ignores extracted pad shape
findings.why_it_matters: A supported shape change to any bridge pad can produce a successful mesh and solver result for the wrong copper geometry. `build_neck_model` accepts both source shape codes but drops the field, then the Gmsh generator chooses a rectangle only for pad 1 and an oval for every other pad. Preserve the extracted shape in `NeckGeometry` and either generate from it or reject any shape that differs from the reviewed per-pad contract, so an input geometry change cannot silently become an unrelated model.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the validated shape to `NeckGeometry`, select the rectangle/oval construction from that field in `neck_geo::generate`, and add mutations that change a pad-2 shape to rectangle and a pad-1 shape to oval, asserting either a correspondingly changed generated geometry or a fail-closed reviewed-shape rejection.
evidence: zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/neck_geometry.rs:335-336 -- ensure!(pad.shape == 1 || pad.shape == 2, "bridge pad {} has unsupported shape {}", pad.pad, pad.shape);
zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/neck_geometry.rs:375-386 -- NeckGeometry stores `pad_number` and dimensions but does not store `pad.shape`.

testing_gaps: No current-manifest integration test supplies a real bridge-neck assessment and proves that the numerical replay path (including the current binding) runs instead of emitting the missing-evidence indeterminate finding.
No geometry mutation test changes an otherwise supported bridge-pad shape and proves that the generated Gmsh solid changes or the model rejects the source.
